{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Blazer, relaxed fit through the hip, charcoal gray (#3f4b5d), wool blend with a fine heathered texture.
Tailored trousers, straight leg, soft slate blue (#5c6b7f), heavy cotton twill.
Silk-blend blouse, pointed collar and subtle puff sleeves, cream (#fdfbf7), lightweight drape fabric.
Loafers, almond toe, dark chocolate brown (#3a2c24), smooth leather with a slight heel.
Gold bar necklace, 18 inches long, polished brass finish.

This outfit honors your request for a workday in the office without anything flashy by using deep, neutral tones that blend seamlessly together. The structured blazer and tailored trousers provide a professional silhouette suitable for an everyday office setting while remaining comfortable for movement. A touch of gold jewelry adds just enough polish to elevate the look without drawing excessive attention, striking the perfect balance between neatness and personal style."}
